# A column (generated by make_env.py): plinth, octagonal shaft, capital, a ring of moss at its foot.
# Origin on the floor at its centre.
new
material new Column --base-color 0.5608 0.5765 0.5373 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.3216 0.3255 0.2980 --no-slot
material new Moss --base-color 0.3647 0.4627 0.2627 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Plinth --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.250
scale 1.500 1.500 0.500
apply --scale
material assign Trim
active Plinth
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Shaft --vertices 8 --radius 0.550 --depth 5.600 --location 0.000 0.000 3.300
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Column
active Shaft
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cone --name MossRing --vertices 8 --radius1 0.680 --radius2 0.580 --depth 0.160 --location 0.000 0.000 0.580
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
material assign Moss
active MossRing
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Capital --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 6.350
scale 1.400 1.400 0.500
apply --scale
material assign Trim
active Capital
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export pillar.glb
